verdict.rationale: Using a flag vendor through OpenFeature providers is a fair question for a feature-flagging product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions OpenFeature or a vendor-neutral provider. It documents only Amplitude's own Experiment SDKs and management APIs, which do not meet the story's goal of avoiding lock-in to one vendor's SDK API.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API
